note: Mirrored byte for byte in Broham01/Nirvana and Broham01/nirvana-xfoundry at docs/integration/contract.json. Both repos test themselves against it; Nirvana's CI also checks that the two copies are identical.

nirvana_api.idempotency: Every POST carries an Idempotency-Key. The same key with a different body is refused (409), so a key is derived from the whole request.

snapshot_format.collector: scripts/collect-k8s-snapshot.py in Nirvana; xFoundry runs it from NIRVANA_DIR and passes --custom for its custom resources

environment_spec.nirvana_use: ADR 0012 step 3 imports this spec for Kubernetes models; Nirvana vendors the schema and does not define its own

name_pattern.rule: {n…} is replaced by the 1-based index padded to the number of n's; a pattern without a placeholder gives name, name-2, name-3

evidence_rule: A plan against a model (source.kind model) can be reviewed but never applied. xFoundry's gate refuses it; Nirvana marks it Modelled.
approval_rule: Only a person signed in to Nirvana approves. No token, scope or xFoundry code path may approve or request changes.

open_items.text: power: half differs. Nirvana's vSphere model generator powers on every other VM (index 0, 2, 4…); xFoundry powers on the first half, rounded up. Agree one rule before Nirvana imports xfoundry.environment/1 (ADR 0012 step 3).
xFoundry polls GET /api/v1/plans/{id} for decisions. A webhook is not built (xFoundry ADR 0002 item 5).
